description: Update a brand's social media content rules for ONE platform. By default this MERGES your provided fields into the existing rules (send only what you want to change — other fields are preserved; arrays you provide replace the old array). Set replace=true to overwrite the entire platform ruleset. Valid platforms: linkedin, x/twitter, facebook, instagram, threads, general. Tip: call get_social_media_rules first to see current values.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

platform.description: The platform whose rules you want to update.

replace.description: Overwrite the entire platform ruleset instead of merging.

rules.description: Partial or full ruleset to apply. Only provide the fields you want to change when merging.

avoid.description: Things to avoid when posting on this platform.

content.description: Controls post length, caption length, paragraph style, reading level, emoji usage, and hashtag strategy.

contentTypes.description: Types of content that perform well on this platform.

engagement.description: Controls how the post drives comments, shares, saves, authenticity signals, and community interaction.

guidelines.description: General writing and posting guidelines for this platform.

principles.description: Core content principles for this platform.

secrets.description: Hidden power tactics or platform-specific tricks.

structure.description: Controls hook style, ending/CTA, links, sentence structure, storytelling, formatting, and thread layout.

visualStrategy.description: Controls visual brand consistency, first-frame hooks, text-on-image usage, branding elements, and quality standards.

name: set_social_media_rules
